description: RBAC-8: every role-name authorization decision has been removed; the list is empty and the ratchet baseline is empty. The decisions for the original 40 sites are kept in role_name_site_decisions.json.

categories.permission_guard: A route or router is guarded by a role name. RBAC-4 replaces it with the listed permission.
categories.permission_bypass: A permission check is skipped for the superadmin by name. RBAC-4 removes the shortcut: the superadmin role holds materialised grants.
categories.assignment_hierarchy: A rule about which roles may be assigned, by name. RBAC-4 replaces it with the escalation ceiling and platform.role.assign_platform.
categories.scope_cross_org: The superadmin by name widens which organisation's data a query returns. This is scope, not a permission: deferred to RBAC-5.
categories.organization_switch: The superadmin names another organisation to act in. RBAC-4/5: platform.organization.switch plus the scope model.
categories.default_role: The self-registration default is looked up by role name. RBAC-4: the rbac_default_roles reference.
categories.provisioning_lookup: A role is looked up by name to give it to a new account. RBAC-4: by role key, in a seed/bootstrap context.
categories.bootstrap: First-run provisioning of the initial administrator. A permitted seed/bootstrap context; moves to a role key.
categories.legacy_authority: The legacy check itself. Removed with the legacy model in RBAC-8.
